summary: The 320x480 ad unit has three critical blockers: (1) unsafe CTA button positioning with insufficient bottom margin (likely <20px from frame edge in settled state), (2) carousel indicator dots not properly aligned and active state unclear, and (3) product image quality/sizing issues in the settled carousel slide. Minor warnings include typography hierarchy polish and color consistency on secondary elements. The ad requires immediate patch fixes to the CTA safe zone, carousel indicators, and product image display before approval.

findings.issue: Primary CTA button 'Voir toutes les offres' has insufficient bottom safe margin. In settled state, the button appears to be less than 20px from the bottom edge of #ad-320x480 (480px frame). Safe zone requirement: 20px clear space below CTA inside the ad frame.
findings.fix_hint: #ad-320x480 .cta-button { margin-bottom: 20px; } or increase padding-bottom on the container holding the button to guarantee 20px clearance from bottom of #ad-320x480.

findings.issue: Carousel/product indicator dots (navigation circles) are misaligned and active state is ambiguous. In initial and animated states, the active dot should be clearly visually distinct (filled yellow or larger). In settled state, the indicator alignment and active state do not match expected carousel position.
findings.fix_hint: For carousel indicators, apply clear active state styling: .carousel-indicator.active { background-color: #FFF000; } and ensure all indicators are vertically/horizontally centered. Verify dot size is consistent (~12px diameter) and active dot stands out with Lidl brand yellow (#FFF000).

findings.issue: Product image in settled carousel slide (Kit dessin premium) appears small or poorly framed within the product hero area. Image may be missing proper aspect ratio or sizing, reducing visual impact of the product and violating layout consistency with initial slide.
findings.fix_hint: #ad-320x480 .product-image { width: 100%; height: auto; max-width: 280px; object-fit: cover; } Verify the product image src path is correct and the image is loaded. If image path is broken, correct the src URL in the HTML.

findings.issue: Typography hierarchy: Product category label ('EN LIGNE SEULEMENT', 'LOISIRS CRÉATIFS · CRELANDO') is small and low contrast against the blue background in settled state. Readability could be improved.
findings.fix_hint: #ad-320x480 .product-category { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #FFF000; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } Consider using Lidl brand yellow (#FFF000) or white (#FFFFFF) for better contrast on primary blue (#0050AA).

findings.issue: Price strikethrough styling ('40.99 €' → '21,99 €') uses a simple line-through in initial/animated, but the visual hierarchy between old and new price could be stronger. New price should dominate more visually.
findings.fix_hint: #ad-320x480 .old-price { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: 0.7; font-size: 14px; color: #FFFFFF; } #ad-320x480 .new-price { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 900; color: #FFF000; } Ensure font-size ratio is at least 2:1 for strong hierarchy.
